🎬"Ishq Murshid"  is a hit Pakistani romantic TV series. It follows Shahmeer Sikandar, a rich politician's son, who falls for Shibra Salman, a brave, principled woman who hates political corruption. To win her heart, Shahmeer disguises himself as an ordinary, simple man named Fazal Baksh. 

Main Plot and Deception

Shahmeer's Background: Shahmeer (played by Bilal Abbas Khan) returns from abroad after studying. He stays away from his father's corrupt political life, carrying pain from his mother's death. 

Shibra's Values: Shibra (played by Durefishan Saleem) comes from a middle-class, disciplined family. She works hard to clear her civil service exams and despises dishonest people. 

The Disguise: When Shahmeer falls for Shibra at first sight, he realizes she would never accept a wealthy elite or politician's son. He adopts the persona of a humble, quirky worker named Fazal Baksh to enter her life and win her family's trust.
